name: Pad see ew with mixed seafood
notes: Rachel Cooks Thai (8 oz fresh wide noodles, 1/2 cup chicken, 2 cups Chinese broccoli, 1 egg, 2 tbsp sweet dark soy, 2 tbsp oyster sauce for 2 plates), RecipeTin Eats (200 g dried noodles, 150 g chicken thigh, 1 egg, 1.5 tbsp oyster sauce, 3 tbsp oil for 2 to 3 plates) and Eating Thai Food (300 g fresh noodles, 200 g meat, 1 egg, 2 tbsp oil). Per plate 200 g of cooked wide rice noodles (RecipeTin Eats' 200 g dried noodles feed 2 to 3), one egg, 20 g of oil (RecipeTin Eats' 3 tbsp over 2 plates, about 1.5 tbsp each); protein is the cooked weight, 60 g.
